from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "tests"))
import mountainash as ma
import narwhals as nw
from fixtures.backend_helpers import BackendDataFrameFactory

for provider in ("polars", "narwhals-pandas"):
    frame = BackendDataFrameFactory.create({"text": [None, "anchor"]}, provider)
    native_frame = nw.from_native(frame)
    for method in ("contains", "starts_with", "ends_with"):
        expr = getattr(ma.col("text").str, method)("x", case_sensitive="CASE_INSENSITIVE_ASCII")
        public = ma.relation(frame).select(expr.alias("result")).to_dict()["result"]
        native_expr = nw.col("text").str.to_lowercase()
        native_expr = native_expr.str.contains("x", literal=True) if method == "contains" else getattr(native_expr.str, method)("x")
        native = native_frame.select(native_expr.alias("result")).get_column("result").to_list()
        print(provider, method, "public", public, "native-adapter", native)

from importlib.metadata import version
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl
import mountainash as ma

values = ["ße", "ﬃle", "hello world"]
polars_native = pl.DataFrame({"text": values}).select(pl.col("text").str.to_titlecase()).get_column("text").to_list()
pandas_native = pd.Series(values).str.title().tolist()
frame = pd.DataFrame({"text": values})
for method in ("title", "initcap"):
    expr = getattr(ma.col("text").str, method)()
    result = ma.relation(frame).select(expr.alias("result")).to_dict()["result"]
    assert result == pandas_native
    print("public narwhals-pandas", method, result)
print("direct polars", version("polars"), polars_native)
print("direct pandas", version("pandas"), pandas_native)
print("narwhals adapter", version("narwhals"))
print("unicode discrepancy", polars_native != pandas_native)
